text.HIDDEN: Several people reported this listing. It stays hidden until a moderator checks it.
text.EXPIRED_DATE: The listing passed its expiry date. Renew it to show it again.
text.DEMO_HIDDEN: This is demo content, and demo data is switched off for visitors.
text.OWNER_INACTIVE: The owner's account is suspended, so the listing is not shown.

important.title: Good to know

policy.FLEXIBLE: You can cancel up to 24 hours before arrival.
policy.MODERATE: You can cancel up to 5 days before arrival.
policy.STRICT: You can cancel up to 14 days before arrival.
policy.none: Agree on the cancellation terms with the host before you arrive.

important.paymentText: You pay the host when you arrive. Bayit never takes payment.
important.videoTip: Ask for a live video call that shows you the place and a sheet of paper with today's date and the listing number (<ltr>{id}</ltr>).
